overview: 36 official Group 1 Qs (2008–2024) on national income, poverty, employment schemes, unemployment and urban schemes. Mostly one-liners (who/when/which scheme), with assertion-reason and statement-based items rising since 2023. Schemes (10 Qs) and national income concepts (7 Qs) carry the most weight; 2 Qs were deleted by APPSC.

possibility.angle: National income concepts, sectors and definitions
possibility.what_they_ask: GDP/GNP/NDP identities (NFIA, depreciation, net indirect taxes), what is excluded from NI, which sector an activity belongs to, which economist gave which NI definition, A-R on product = income

possibility.angle: India's National Accounts – history, agencies, growth drivers
possibility.what_they_ask: first NI estimate (Naoroji), agency that estimates GDP (CSO/NSO), structural change of NI, current growth drivers (PFCE, capex); also a stray statistics item (Pearson r range)

possibility.angle: Demographic issues – working-age share, demographic dividend
possibility.what_they_ask: the 15–64 age band, working-age share percentage, dependency ratio logic

possibility.angle: Poverty and inequality – estimates, MPI, SDG/UN targets
possibility.what_they_ask: Tendulkar poverty ratios by year, MPI method (Alkire-Foster, H×A), rural vs urban decline, UN poverty decade years, SDG-1 target, theorist of surplus value
Census 2011 cultivators vs agricultural labourers, which NSSO status measures chronic unemployment, causes of jobless growth

possibility.angle: Employment and poverty-eradication schemes (central and AP)
possibility.what_they_ask: launch year (20-point programme), which scheme is post-1991, renamed/merged successor (SGSY → Aajeevika, Velugu → IKP), who borrows (SHGs), MGNREGA features and women's share, UBI idea from Economic Survey 2016-17

possibility.evidence: 0 official Qs; asked in other APPSC exams (e.g. first state with an EGS – Maharashtra; MGNREGA in force Feb 2006)
possibility.what_they_ask: natural targets judging by the scheme items: PMGSY, PMAY-G, DAY-NRLM, Rurban Mission ministry, RIDF (NABARD), launch years and nodal ministries

possibility.angle: Urban development – urban missions and funds
possibility.what_they_ask: target group of VAMBAY, scope of JNNURM, which mission is not urban (Rurban), UIDF funding source and manager (NHB)

traps.trap: Offers a restructuring year instead of the launch year
traps.spot: Option list contains several years tied to one programme
traps.pyq: '20-point Economic Programme [...] introduced by Smt. Indira Gandhi' → 1975 [group1-prelims-2008#31]

traps.trap: Swaps the three NI adjustments (NFIA, depreciation, net indirect taxes)
traps.spot: Identity options that look alike but differ in what is subtracted
traps.fix: National vs domestic = ±NFIA; gross vs net = ±depreciation; market price vs factor cost = ±NIT
traps.pyq: 'GDPmp = GNPmp – Net Income from Abroad' is the only correct identity [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#71]

traps.trap: Puts utilities in the primary or service sector
traps.spot: Water supply / electricity / gas in a sector question or match list
traps.fix: Utilities and construction are secondary (industry); trade and transport are services

traps.trap: Names an old or sibling scheme instead of the current successor
traps.fix: Track the lineage: SGSY (1999) → NRLM 'Aajeevika' (2011) → DAY-NRLM; Velugu was merged into IKP
traps.pyq: 'SGSY at present implemented as' → Aajeevika [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#76]; AP umbrella scheme → Indira Kranthi Pathakam [group1-prelims-2010#79]

traps.trap: Borrows the goal of a different scheme into a 'feature' list
traps.spot: A 'not a feature of' list with one item from another sector (food, health)
traps.fix: MGNREGS = rights-based rural wage employment; food is NFSA/ICDS/PM-POSHAN
traps.pyq: 'Provision of nutritious food' is not MGNREGS (Q deleted for its codes, the fact stands) [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#65]

traps.trap: Reverses a comparison or a policy stance
traps.spot: 'larger decline in urban than rural', 'shift away from capital expenditure'
traps.fix: Rural MPI poverty fell faster than urban; public capex was sustained as a growth driver
traps.pyq: 'urban population witnessed a larger decline' → false [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#78]; 'shift from capital expenditure' → false [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#61]

traps.spot: 'does not use Alkire-Foster', 'adding incidence and intensity'
traps.fix: National MPI uses Alkire-Foster like the global MPI; MPI = H × A (product)
traps.pyq: Statements I and IV false, only III valid [group1-prelims-2024-paper1#78]

traps.trap: Substitutes the managing institution or user of a fund
traps.spot: Fund statements naming a manager, source and eligible borrowers
traps.fix: UIDF: from PSL shortfall, managed by NHB, used by public agencies for MoHUA missions (mirror of NABARD's RIDF)

traps.trap: Gives a rural scheme in a list of urban missions
traps.spot: Negative stem 'does not provide urban rejuvenation'
traps.fix: Rurban (SPMRM) is MoRD, rural clusters; AMRUT, HRIDAY, SBM-Urban are urban

techniques.name: Three-switch identity check
techniques.how: For any NI identity, ask which pair it converts (national/domestic, gross/net, mp/fc) and confirm the single adjustment that pair uses. Discard options that use the wrong adjustment.
techniques.example: Options [1]–[4]: GDPmp vs GNPmp is a national/domestic switch → only NFIA fits; options with depreciation or NIT fall → option 2 [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#71]

techniques.name: Scheme timeline elimination
techniques.how: Keep a launch-year ladder (FWP 1977, NREP 1980, RLEGP 1983, JRY 1989, PMRY 1993, SGSY 1999, MGNREGA 2006). Eliminate options on the wrong side of the date in the stem.
techniques.example: 'started after 1991': FWP, NREP, JRY all pre-1991 → PMRY (1993) [group1-prelims-2008#77]

techniques.name: Transfer-payment filter
techniques.how: In 'not included in NI' items, look for a payment with no current production in return (pension, interest on public debt, scholarship, second-hand sale).
techniques.example: Wages, PSU profits and taxes link to production; interest on public debt is a transfer → option 3 [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#70]

techniques.name: A-R by arithmetic
techniques.how: When A is a growth/per-capita claim, write the identity (PCI growth ≈ NI growth – population growth) and test whether R is exactly that cause.
techniques.example: Population growth > NI growth gives falling PCI, so R explains A → both true, R explains [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#63]

techniques.name: Match-list anchor pair
techniques.how: Fix the surest pair first (GDP → CSO), then the unusual one (water supply → industry); usually only one code survives.
techniques.example: d-III and b-IV leave only 'II IV I III' [group1-prelims-2023-paper1#69]

techniques.name: Measure-to-method pairing
techniques.how: For unemployment, link the concept in the stem to the NSSO status: chronic → usual status, weekly → CWS, daily/underemployment → CDS.

confusions.remember: NFIA moves domestic ↔ national; NIT moves market price ↔ factor cost
US = chronic (year); CDS = daily, catches underemployment, gives the highest rate
21.9% is the official Tendulkar figure; 29.8% is Tendulkar 2009-10
MDG halve extreme poverty by 2015; SDG end poverty in all forms by 2030
Swarozgar = self-employment via SHGs; Rozgar/Gram Samridhi = wage work
Velugu (DPIP) is the component merged into the IKP umbrella
Rurban = rural clusters given urban amenities
Both from PSL shortfall; RIDF → NABARD (rural), UIDF → NHB (urban)
VAMBAY (2001) = urban slum BPL; IAY = rural housing
Naoroji first estimate (1867-68); VKRV Rao first scientific (1931)
Census 2011: labourers (14.4 cr) overtook cultivators (11.9 cr) for the first time
Match each NI definition to its author; Hicks equated NSP and social income

anchors: Feb 2006 – MGNREGA in force; 100 days per household; at least 1/3 women by law, actual ~56% (2016-17)
1993 – PMRY, the post-1991 option among old wage schemes
Dec 2005 – JNNURM for 60+ mission cities (sub-missions UIG, BSUP)
Dec 2001 – VAMBAY for urban slum BPL households
15–64 years – working-age band for demographic dividend
1997–2006 – first UN Decade for the Eradication of Poverty
MPI = H × A, Alkire-Foster method (global and NITI national MPI)
Interest on public debt, pensions, scholarships = transfers, excluded from NI
checklist: Which NI pair is being switched – is the adjustment the right one?
Is the year offered the launch year or a revision/renaming year?
Is the scheme rural or urban, wage or self-employment, and which ministry runs it?
Does the stem ask the current successor name of an old scheme?
In statements, check direction words (larger/smaller, shift towards/away) against the actual trend
For any rate or ratio, confirm the method and the year it belongs to
Note whether the item is time-sensitive (survey year) before relying on a current figure
